description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Persistent Specimen, adding {C}{C}.
When Persistent Specimen dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and goading it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Persistent Specimen by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
